description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related functions for gathering system information such as CPU load, memory, hardware details, and system control operations within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes platform-specific code for Linux, macOS, and Windows, and references multiple internal and external headers.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Class providing system information such as hardware details, CPU load, memory stats, and system control functions within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Nested class capturing a snapshot of system memory info from /proc/meminfo.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the specified network interface or the first available MAC address if none specified.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Id
methods.description: Generates a unique system ID based on device MAC address and prefix.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateCpuStats
methods.description: Updates CPU load statistics, platform-specific implementations for Linux and macOS.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateRealtimeInfo
methods.description: Updates real-time system info such as memory and uptime, platform-specific for macOS and Linux.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTime
methods.description: Sets the system time based on a provided Time object, platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo (Windows only).
